select.$description: Select component tokens. The 'field' trigger reuses the shared field tokens (border, sizes, label, hint, error); these add the compact trigger, the chevron and the pop-up list. Evidence: audit families F11 select (1 instance, custom-built, no native select anywhere) and F17 filter dropdown (70 instances, 8 variants, 11 designs).

height.$description: OBSERVED: 40px outlined pills with 16px text beside the filter pills on AcmeCo's desktop results (reference screenshots, 2026-10-11). Was 32px; 40px since decision 45, the same as filter.height.

padding-x.$description: OBSERVED: about 16px either side, as the filter pills (decision 45; was 12px).

radius.$description: OBSERVED: pill filter chips (34px, 281 el); compact triggers sit beside chips.

font-size.$description: OBSERVED: 16px on AcmeCo's desktop pills (decision 45; was 14px).

height-touch.$description: OBSERVED: AcmeCo's phone shows "For Lease" as a 40px pill with 16px text and no chevron (a reference screenshot, 2026-10-11); below 768px the compact Select matches the filter pills (decision 42).

border.$description: OBSERVED: light grey outline (decorative; the shadow separates it too).

shadow.$description: OBSERVED: the most widespread raised shadow (5 exp). Figma: the shadow/raised effect style.

max-height.$description: PROPOSED: about eight options before the list scrolls.

min-height.$description: PROPOSED: 40px rows, comfortable to tap (above the 24px minimum).

gap.$description: PROPOSED: between the label and the check mark.

selected-weight.$description: PROPOSED: selected = semibold plus a check mark, not colour alone.

icon-size.$description: PROPOSED: check mark on the selected option.

background-focused.$description: PROPOSED: the option under the keyboard or mouse. Not observed.
